common.noProbability: Calculated deterministically from the plan and the working calendar — no probability is estimated.
common.title: Title

plan.subtitle: WBS, timeline, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, baselines, look-ahead, what-if and health — all from the same plan data.

wbs.title: Work breakdown structure
wbs.empty: No activities in this plan yet.
wbs.draftHint: Draft activities are proposed by the template and are not yet confirmed into the plan. Confirming them does not invent dates or owners.
wbs.activateAllEffect: Draft activities in this workstream ({count}) become Not started and part of the confirmed plan.
wbs.activateAllScope: Durations, dates and owners are not changed; activities already confirmed are not affected.
wbs.progressLegend: Progress shows reported / evidence-verified. Only acceptance by someone other than the submitter counts as verified.

task.durationHint: Leave empty when to be determined — the schedule then reports it as a gap.
task.requiresAcceptanceHint: completion must be accepted, with evidence, by someone other than the submitter
task.progressHint: Reported progress is the owner's claim. Evidence-verified progress comes only from acceptance.
task.progressRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
task.draftNotice: This activity is still Draft (proposed by the template). Confirm it into the plan before work starts.
task.whatIfLink: Analyse a delay of this activity

milestone.evidenceHint: Achievement is verified only with at least one active evidence link, by someone other than the person who reported it.

deliverable.weightHint: Only approved weights count toward progress; a changed weight must be approved again, by someone other than the person who set it.
deliverable.approveWeightsEffect: The weights of the deliverables listed on this page ({count}) become approved and start counting toward weighted progress.
deliverable.weightResets: Changing the weight withdraws its approval.

owner.title: Accountable owner — {code}
owner.first: This record has no accountable owner yet.
owner.replaces: The current owner, {user}, will be replaced (requires the reassignment permission).
owner.memberRule: Only active members of this project can be owners. Each record has exactly one accountable owner.

raci.title: RACI
raci.hint: One accountable owner (A); additional Responsible, Consulted and Informed people or functions.
raci.removeEffect: {who} is removed from this record's RACI.
raci.functionHint: Use a function when the person is still to be confirmed.
raci.accountableRule: Accountability (A) is set with the accountable-owner action — never as a RACI entry.

dependency.typeHint: Only finish-to-start (FS) is supported; other types are refused until each is tested.
dependency.rules: The server rejects cycles, links to other projects and unsupported types. Lag is counted in working days on the project calendar.

schedule.targetHint: Choose an activity to see only the network that drives it (its transitive predecessors).
schedule.incompleteHint: No critical path is reported until these gaps are fixed ({count}):
schedule.issue_cycle: is part of a dependency cycle
schedule.issue_missing_project_start: The project has no planned start date
schedule.plannedOnly: Because the schedule is incomplete, the timeline shows planned dates only — not a calculated forecast.

gantt.caption: Timeline
gantt.empty: No activities with dates in this scope.

baseline.hint: A baseline freezes start, finish, duration, deliverable weights, budget lines and the perimeter scope. After the first approval, a re-baseline needs an approved change request.
baseline.proposeEffect: The current confirmed plan is frozen as a new proposed baseline (with a snapshot hash).
baseline.proposeApproval: It becomes the approved baseline only when someone other than you approves it.
baseline.approveEffect: Baseline v{version} becomes the approved baseline; the previous approved baseline is kept as superseded.
baseline.approveWeights: Unchanged deliverable weights in the snapshot become approved.
baseline.rejectEffect: The proposal is rejected and stays on record.
baseline.rebaselineHint: Only approved change requests flagged for re-baselining and not yet used are listed.
baseline.noApprovedCr: No approved re-baselining change request available
baseline.frozenHint: The snapshot and its hash cannot be changed after proposal.
baseline.budgetRestricted: Budget lines: {count} (restricted — not shown with your access)
baseline.noTasks: No confirmed tasks in this baseline.
baseline.selfNotice: You proposed this baseline, so someone else must approve or reject it.

whatIf.hint: What if an activity slips? The impact is calculated on the plan and the project calendar; nothing in the plan changes.
whatIf.targetHint: Optional: a milestone whose driving network is analysed.
whatIf.incomplete: The impact cannot be calculated while the schedule has gaps ({count}). Fix the gaps in the timeline first.

health.progressHint: Approved deliverable weights; only accepted deliverables count as done.
health.basis: {num} of {den} approved weight points accepted, across {count} deliverables.
health.worstOf: Worst of the workstreams and critical milestones — a green average never hides a red item.
health.thresholds: Proposed thresholds: green up to {green} working days of slip, amber up to {amber}, updates stale after {stale} days.
health.noBaseline: No approved baseline — variance cannot be measured yet.
health.dataQualityHint: Unknown, not updated and stale never count as green.
health.ruleHint: Open blockers make the status red; missing or old updates are never green.
health.asOf: Calculated on {date} ({tz}). Published report snapshots are not recalculated.

override.title: Manual status overrides
override.hint: An override needs a reason, an expiry date and review by someone other than the requester. The calculated status is always kept.
override.rules: Overrides expire automatically (at most 90 days) and never hide an open blocker from the project status.
override.expiresHint: After this date the calculated status applies again.
override.approveEffect: The effective status becomes {status} until {date}; the calculated status stays visible.
override.rejectEffect: The calculated status continues to apply.

update.title: Periodic updates
update.hint: Updates are submitted, reviewed by someone else and accepted; accepted updates are frozen as historical reporting versions.
update.ragHint: Your judgement — shown beside the calculated status, never instead of it.
update.ragCompare: The calculated status is recorded at submission and frozen at acceptance.
update.frozenNotice: This update was accepted and is frozen. Later plan changes do not alter it.

raid.subtitle: Risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies with owners, exposure and escalation — and change requests with impact assessment and approval.
raid.blockingRule: Open issues of severity 4–5 count as blockers and make the workstream red.
raid.raiseIssueEffect: An issue is created from {code} (the risk has materialised); the risk stays open until its owner closes it.
raid.heatAxes: Rows: probability (5 = very high). Columns: impact.

cr.empty: No change requests match the filters.
cr.hint: Draft → submitted → under review (impact assessment) → approved or rejected by someone other than the requester → implemented. A re-baselining change is implemented with a new approved baseline.
cr.impactsHint: Time, cost, scope, readiness, transaction, financial and TSA impacts. Approval requires at least one recorded impact.
cr.noImpacts: No impact recorded yet — the request cannot be approved.
cr.rebaselineHint: implementation needs a new approved baseline linked to this request
cr.rebaselineNext: Approved: propose the new baseline linked to this change request, then mark it implemented.
cr.subject: Subject
cr.assessHint: Describe each impact in plain language; leave a field empty when it does not apply.
cr.selfNotice: You requested this change, so someone else must approve or reject it.

commands.evidenceRule: At least one active evidence link is required and no conflicting evidence may be open.
commands.notSelf: Separation of duties: the person who requested or submitted it cannot approve it.

task.activateEffect: The Draft activity becomes Not started and part of the confirmed plan.
task.startEffect: The task becomes In progress with the actual start date below.
task.blockEffect: The task becomes Blocked; its workstream shows red until the blocker is cleared.
task.unblockEffect: The task returns to In progress.
task.submitEffect: Reported complete; the approver is notified. Verified progress changes only when someone else accepts it.
task.acceptEffect: The task becomes Accepted and counts as evidence-verified complete.
task.rejectEffect: The task goes back to In progress with your reason.
task.completeEffect: Only for tasks that do not require acceptance: the task becomes Done (reported, not evidence-verified).
task.cancelEffect: The task is excluded from progress — it never counts as complete.
task.reopenEffect: The task returns to In progress; any previous acceptance is withdrawn.

milestone.reportEffect: The milestone is reported achieved and waits for evidence verification.
milestone.rejectEvidenceEffect: The milestone goes back to At risk; verification is withdrawn.
milestone.flagEffect: The milestone is marked At risk with your reason.
milestone.missedEffect: The milestone is marked Missed; a critical one turns the project red.
milestone.cancelEffect: The milestone is cancelled and excluded.

deliverable.submitEffect: The deliverable is submitted; the approver is notified.
deliverable.acceptEffect: The deliverable becomes Accepted and its approved weight counts toward progress.
deliverable.rejectEffect: The deliverable is rejected with your reason and can be resubmitted.
deliverable.cancelEffect: Excluded from the progress denominator — never counted as complete.
deliverable.reopenEffect: The deliverable returns to In progress; any acceptance is withdrawn.

raid.monitorEffect: The item is monitored until its trigger is reached.
raid.escalateEffect: The escalation level rises above the current level ({level}); the highest level is 3.
raid.mitigateEffect: The response is in place; the residual exposure is accepted.
raid.closeEffect: The item is closed with your reason.
raid.cancelEffect: The item is cancelled (recorded in error or no longer applicable).
raid.reopenEffect: The item is reopened with your reason.

cr.submitEffect: The change request is submitted for impact review.
cr.startReviewEffect: The request moves to Under review; impacts can then be assessed.
cr.approveEffect: The change request is approved. A re-baselining change still needs a new approved baseline.
cr.rejectEffect: The change request is rejected with your reason.
cr.withdrawEffect: The change request is withdrawn and stays on record.
cr.implementEffect: The approved change is recorded as implemented.
cr.implementRebaseline: Allowed only once a baseline linked to this request has been approved.

update.submitEffect: The update is submitted; the calculated status is recorded beside your reported status.
update.acceptEffect: The update and its metrics are frozen as a historical reporting version.
update.returnEffect: The update goes back to its author with your reason.

ws.reportedAvg: Average reported progress of active tasks: {value}% (a claim, not verified).

inbox.subtitle: What needs your action across your projects — tasks you own, acceptances, reviews and approvals you may give, committee actions and votes.
inbox.empty: Nothing needs your action right now.
inbox.emptyHint: Items appear here when you own open work or when something awaits your review or approval.

tile.scheduleIncomplete: Whole-plan schedule incomplete: {count} gap(s); no project finish is forecast.
tile.noSlip: No workstream is forecast later than baseline v{version}.
